data.name: Copy the file to your AnduinOS computer, then open Offline Updater in Settings and choose the file. The app will check compatibility before you start.
data.value: Salin file ke komputer AnduinOS Anda, lalu buka Offline Updater di Pengaturan dan pilih file tersebut. Aplikasi akan memeriksa kompatibilitas sebelum Anda memulai.

data.name: Download here. Open in Offline Updater. Update without an Internet connection.
data.value: Unduh di sini. Buka di Pembaruan Luring. Perbarui tanpa koneksi Internet.

data.name: Downloads are temporarily unavailable.
data.value: Unduhan tidak tersedia untuk sementara waktu.

data.name: Each package is cumulative. You do not need to download every earlier update.
data.value: Setiap paket bersifat kumulatif. Anda tidak perlu mengunduh setiap pembaruan sebelumnya.

data.name: Offline update packages will appear here when they are ready.
data.value: Paket pembaruan offline akan muncul di sini saat siap.

data.name: Please try again in a few moments.
data.value: Silakan coba lagi dalam beberapa saat.

data.name: Stay up to date. Even offline.
System and security updates in one download.
data.value: Pembaruan sistem dan keamanan dalam satu unduhan.

data.name: Your next update is on its way.
data.value: Pembaruan berikutnya Anda sedang dalam proses.
